baseline.equivalence_test: The baseline root with answer_corroboration strength=0 produces the unchanged baseline interaction matrix and K-set on synthetic fixtures.

core_invariants: Retrieval, data loading, gold answers, generation, QA metrics, and reporting rules remain outside the enhancer.
Answer evidence is computed once and passed as a read-only context object; the plugin cannot change reader outputs.
The decisive_conflict feature is diagnostic-only and is not included in the QUBO objective.
The collaborator output contains compact identifiers and metrics only, with no raw questions, passages, answers, or predictions.

interfaces.input_schema: baseline interaction matrix, normalized relevance, redundancy matrix, precomputed answer evidence matrices
reader answer hypotheses and passage confidence
interfaces.output_schema: agreement, legacy conflict, decisive conflict, duplication, corroboration matrices

plugins.hypothesis: The established QORE redundancy objective remains the fixed control.
failure_signatures: baseline K-set changes with enhancer strength zero

plugins.insertion_point: after baseline root and before QUBO solve
plugins.hypothesis: Stable agreement/corroboration signals can reward jointly supported passages without penalizing useful answer diversity.
plugins.input_schema: baseline interaction matrix and selected answer evidence matrix
plugins.resource_estimate: One matrix lookup and O(N^2) scaling per selection
failure_signatures: baseline equivalence fails at zero strength

plugins.insertion_point: after reader hypotheses and before selection
plugins.hypothesis: A stricter high-confidence/high-margin divergence feature is less confounded than the legacy conflict score.
plugins.input_schema: answer hypotheses, agreement matrix, passage confidence
plugins.resource_estimate: O(N^2) over cached hypotheses; no extra reader pass
failure_signatures: feature remains positive for low-margin pairs

composition.merge_rule: The baseline is the only replace root; answer_corroboration adds a normalized negative pair reward. decisive_conflict_diagnostic is parallel observation only.

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic direct and prefiltered selector fixtures preserve baseline output when the new plugin has zero strength.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation questions 100-149 with Wiki-DPR compressed retrieval
reproducibility.environment: record Python executable/version, git revision, reference generator path, dataset slice, K=5, seed=42, and plugin tree

limitations: This stage is a mechanism ablation and does not establish a paper-level method gain.
The decisive_conflict feature is not a logical contradiction detector and is diagnostic-only.
The first collaborator pilot uses one generator, one K, and 50 held-out questions; transfer confirmation remains a later gate.
